info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Data Update API
info.description: The Employee Data Update API facilitates the modification of existing employee records within the human resource management system. This endpoint allows authorized users to patch specific attributes of employee data, ensuring that information remains accurate and up-to-date. Common consumers of this API include human resources personnel and systems integrators who need to maintain employee records effectively. Use cases may involve updating employee statuses, contact details, or other pertinent information as part of workforce management processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update existing employee data by providing the employee ID and the fields to be modified. Ensure that you have the correct permissions before making updates.

requestBody.description: This request body expects updates to the employee data associated with the given employee ID (EMP-900045). The payload should contain the necessary fields to modify employee records, which may include personal information, job details, and other relevant attributes. Ensure that the data adheres to the specified schema.
